title: EXOZ to host Q2 2026 investor update on Aug 20 @ 5PM Eastern
summary: Los Angeles, CA -- August 11, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - announced the plan to host a webinar on Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss its results for the second quarter 2026. A press release detailing these results will be issued prior to the call.
body_markdown: **Los Angeles, CA -- August 11, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) -** **a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines** **- announced the plan to host a webinar on Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss its results for the second quarter 2026. A press release detailing these results will be issued prior to the call.**
